# InstaLabel

> InstaLabel is kitchen labelling software for food businesses. Staff keep item, ingredient, allergen and date information in one place and print labels from the web app or the Android app.

The current public promotion is the Christmas offer. It is for new customers only and ends on 10 January 2027.

- New customers receive 60 days free.
- An annual plan also receives 30% off the first annual payment. The following renewal is the full price.
- A monthly plan receives the 60 days, then the normal monthly price. The 30% does not apply to monthly billing.
- Payment details are collected at checkout. There is no charge during the free period. The subscription can be cancelled at any time.
- The customer-facing code, when one is active, is shown on the Christmas offer page. Someone who has already had a subscription cannot use the offer.
- The standing price is £15.99 a month. Outside the promotion, new subscriptions start with a 14-day trial.
- InstaLabel does not guarantee compliance. It does not include iOS printing, nutrition or a POS connection. Temperature checks for equipment, food and deliveries are recorded in the dashboard.

## Offer

- [Christmas offer](https://www.instalabel.co/christmas): 60 days free for new customers, plus 30% off the first annual payment. Ends 10 January 2027.

- [PrintBridge](https://www.instalabel.co/printbridge): Windows and Mac printing.
- [Android app](https://www.instalabel.co/mobile-app): Supported Bluetooth printing.
- [Label sizes](https://www.instalabel.co/label-sizes): 60×40 mm and 56×80 mm layouts.
- [Kitchen label printer](https://www.instalabel.co/kitchen-label-printer): How to choose a setup.
- [CSV import](https://www.instalabel.co/csv-import): Bring in existing ingredient and menu information.

- [About](https://www.instalabel.co/about): The company, in Bournemouth, England.
- [Book a demo](https://www.instalabel.co/bookdemo): See the workflow with your own labels in mind.

## Labels

- [Workflows](https://www.instalabel.co/uses): Prep, cooked, defrost, date and PPDS labels.
- [Prep labels](https://www.instalabel.co/prep-labels): Food made ahead of service.
- [Cooked labels](https://www.instalabel.co/cooked-labels): Cooked food date labels.
- [Defrost labels](https://www.instalabel.co/defrost-labels): Food leaving the freezer.
- [Opened food labels](https://www.instalabel.co/opened-food-labels): An ingredient label for a pack that has been opened. There is no separate opened label type.
- [Use-first labels](https://www.instalabel.co/use-first-labels): Stock-rotation priority.
- [Expiry date labels](https://www.instalabel.co/expiry-date-labels): Dates from the kitchen's rules.
- [Ingredient labels](https://www.instalabel.co/ingredient-labels): Ingredient information for labels.
- [PPDS labels](https://www.instalabel.co/natashas-law): PPDS labelling software.
- [Dissolvable kitchen labels](https://www.instalabel.co/dissolvable-kitchen-labels): What to check on the stock.

## Allergens, cleaning and procedures

- [Allergen labelling](https://www.instalabel.co/allergen-compliance): Food allergen labelling software.
- [The 14 allergens](https://www.instalabel.co/allergen-guide): UK regulated categories.
- [Allergen matrix](https://www.instalabel.co/allergen-matrix): A matrix from saved item records.
- [Free allergen matrix](https://www.instalabel.co/tools/allergen-matrix): A manual matrix you can download as a PDF.
- [Cleaning checklists](https://www.instalabel.co/cleaning-checklists): Recurring cleaning tasks inside the account. Staff mark them done in the Android app.
- [Free tools](https://www.instalabel.co/tools): The free allergen matrix PDF.
- [HACCP and labelling](https://www.instalabel.co/haccp-labels): How labels sit inside wider procedures.

- [Caterers](https://www.instalabel.co/for/caterers): Batch labels for catering preparation.
